description: This file defines the ArticlesController class in an ASP.NET Core project, handling HTTP requests related to articles such as listing, retrieving details, creating, editing, and deleting articles. It acts as an API controller using MediatR to delegate requests to handlers.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: API controller managing article-related endpoints, utilizing dependency injection of IMediator for handling requests.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list articles with optional filters and pagination.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve the user's personalized feed of articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve article details by slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new article, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update an existing article identified by slug, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove an article by slug, requiring authorization.
